project_roadmap_ref.concern: initiative direction and selected research frontier

objective: Determine which foundation architecture—Concordia, Cybernetic Influence, a layered hybrid, or an independent adapter-based product—best supports a generalized cybernetic multiscale agency simulator, using source-level evidence and three representative world-modeling cases, then record an implementation decision and revised roadmap before any further composition expansion.
audience_or_actor: the product owner and the next implementation agent

current_state_ref.concern: completed local composition slices and deferred component-family expansion

desired_outcome: An evidence-backed architecture decision names one authoritative execution design, fairly disposes of the alternatives and existing code, and supplies the next bounded implementation handoff.
success_or_readout: Slices 26A through 26D satisfy R1–R8 in docs/plans/026-concordia-foundation-research.md; no production integration is required unless a separately bounded disposable spike is triggered by a named decision-changing unknown.

evidence_target.claim: The selected foundation preserves the fixed cybernetic product invariants with less replacement, duplicated authority, and maintenance burden than the strongest rejected alternative across all three canonical cases.

applicable_decision_refs.concern: organizations as analytical boundaries rather than executors
separation of location, communication, capability, and authorization

required_capability_refs.concern: canonical analyst outcome and preserved causal-runtime capabilities
invariants, representative cases, evidence rules, and acceptance contract

target_ref.concern: candidate framework source and public extension seams

typed_dependencies.condition: Concordia engine, entity, component, game-master, state, scheduling, checkpoint, and evidence paths are traced at the pinned revision.

target_ref.concern: shared composition contracts and explicit runtime boundary

typed_dependencies.condition: Research distinguishes compile-time validation supplied by data_contracts from implementation discovery and runtime execution left to the consumer.
Further Slice 25 component-family expansion remains paused until 26D records an adopted decision and replacement implementation handoff.

material_unknowns.question: Can Concordia remain the foundation while one typed causal environment owns state, scheduling, adjudication, replay, and evidence without replacing the engine or creating dual authority?
Which Concordia, Generative Agents, or AgentVille capabilities are separable and materially reduce product work under the fixed invariants?
Should data_contracts.composition own the reviewed compile-time seam, and which runtime contracts must remain in the selected environment?
If candidates optimize materially different product goals rather than implementation details, which tradeoff should the product owner select?

non_goals: Implement or migrate to Concordia during the research slice.
Expand the component registry or add another scenario family.
Run live LLM simulations or compare model quality and cost.
Complete the separate MVP stakeholder-comprehension judgment.
non_claims: Concordia or Cybernetic Influence has a unique theoretical ability to represent typed state or natural language.
Framework defaults alone determine the correct architecture.
The selected product will be empirically predictive or universally faithful.
data_contracts.composition supplies runtime discovery or execution.
